_about: C4 bad-word rule (LDNOOBW English, TFDS matching) on the 2,617 documents run0 finally kept: 147 match; 30 drawn at random (seed 2) and labelled by Claude (the agent that built this page) from the opening lines and the words around the match, 2026-10-15. W: ordinary text the rule would wrongly drop; R: adult, hateful or spam text that should go; U: unclear. Only the matched word and a description are published, never the text.
